context: Tests whether a code-mode cleaning pass deletes narrating and change-history comments, removes unused escape hatches, collapses single-caller wrappers, and renames hedged identifiers, all without changing behavior or the exported API.

checklist.name: Narrating comments deleted
checklist.description: Comments that restate the next line ('Loop through the attempts', 'Call fetch with the provided URL', 'Check if the response was successful', etc.) are gone

checklist.name: Change-history comments deleted
checklist.description: The 'Updated to use the new retry approach as discussed' header and similar session-history narration are removed

checklist.name: Dead options removed
checklist.description: The unused 'strategy' ('Reserved for future use') and 'legacyMode' ('kept just in case') options are deleted from RetryOptions

checklist.name: Wrapper collapsed
checklist.description: The single-caller doActualFetchInternal indirection is inlined; retryFetch calls fetch directly

checklist.name: Hedged names fixed
checklist.description: maybeDelaySafely is renamed to say what it is (e.g. delay/sleep) or inlined; no maybe/safely hedging remains in identifiers

checklist.name: Behavior unchanged
checklist.description: retryFetch keeps the same signature, default of 3 retries, exponential backoff timing, ok-check, and final throw; the error swallow-and-retry semantics in the catch are not altered (removing the console.log is fine, changing what is caught or rethrown is not)

checklist.name: No new slop
checklist.description: The cleanup introduces no comments narrating the cleanup itself and no new defensive code
